title: aquilegia vulgaris subsp. viscosa
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. viscosa, commonly known as the sticky or downy columbine, is a species of flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. viscosa are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe wounds, and exhibit analgesic and anti-diarrheal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
